items.title: Sidney Desvigne Interview, 1958-08-18
items.q: I had a guy who was a stool pigeon farmer. His name was Thomas, Walter Thomas, an outdoor player.

ctx.x: Yeah. So when they would pay off, I'd always get paid when I'd go on a boat. When they had an intermission to go get paid because I'd pay Callie up. Mr. Louise was on there, which is Vernon's wife now, but she was waking for me. And I'd always get my envelope there, and I'd go up there to Callie up. Well, old guy, he was watching, and he never saw me get my envelope, you know. And he had plenty of funny impressions about it. He noticed everything. You know, we always go play a chord when the boat was running…
I remember him. Huh? Floyd Casey. Floyd Casey. That's right.
